A '''light concussion missile''' was an explosive projectile that was fired from a [[light concussion missile launcher]], which was a portable antivehicle [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]]. The [[Missile/Legends|missile]] was a smaller version of the standard [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] that was fired from starships.

Each light concussion missile weighed 10 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]]. It cost 800 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was available for military use only.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy" />
